claim: The building is a medieval hermitage above the terraces
because: The chapel of Saint-Christophe on the Hermitage hill was built in 1864. A primitive chapel had stood there since about 1100, but the building on the label is nineteenth century. Paul Jaboulet Aine has owned it since 1919.
fix: The chapel above the terraces was rebuilt in 1864 on the site of a medieval hermitage, and the house has owned it since 1919; its image goes on the label.
